scenes.text: Missed one call and the job's *gone.*
Ya muppet. Why didn't it text 'em back?
Text 'em back? What are ya on about?
TradeReach, mate. Texts 'em while you're on the tools.
Missed the call? It still gets *answered.*

caption:
Up a ladder, phone buzzing, can't answer. By smoko they've rung someone else. 😤
The caller didn't wait around.
TradeReach texts missed callers back straight away and sends you the job details, so you can ring back when you're off the tools.
👉 Try the live demo at tradereach.net, no signup
